messages:
support_ash: Heads up — NebulaWorks onboarding hit a problem. We created their API key via console but their project (nebula-prod) reports 403 when calling /v1/generate: "project not authorized for key". Key id 01G7aX9kL. Created via OIDC flow at 2026-03-15T13:02Z. They can see the key in the org-level list but it does not appear under the project. Can someone triage? (ticket #4562)
eng_maya: Thanks — pinging provisioning infra. Sounds like a claim/bind propagation failure. Can you paste the provisioner logs and exact repro steps?
support_ash: Repro steps: 1) user signs up with OIDC, 2) onboarding flow creates org and key, 3) customer attempts curl with key against nebula-prod and gets 403. Provisioner log snippet below: 
```
2026-03-15T13:02:11Z provisioner INFO create_key id=01G7aX9kL tenant=nebula-001 bound_project=null claim_status=CLAIM_PENDING
2026-03-15T13:02:12Z provisioner WARN bind_attempt reason="no-project-claim"
```
eng_maya: That WARN means the claim reconciler never saw the project claim or timed out. Could be a webhook delivery/timeout or the watcher queue had backlog. infra-bot, can you show job metadata for job id 9987?
infra-bot: job 9987: provisioner.reconcile.bind key=01G7aX9kL status=partially_applied duration=8s retry_count=0 note="bound to org-level but project binding missing"
devex_jamie: Short-term unblock: run `rwd-admin bind-key --key 01G7aX9kL --project nebula-prod --force` (requires infra role). That will attach the key to the project's service role and should immediately allow calls. Then we can investigate why reconcile didn't complete. Also consider adding a 3x retry with backoff for claim binds.
support_ash: I ran the bind (have infra role). Customer re-tested and now we get 200 on generation and embeddings. They confirmed their CI also picked up the key.
eng_maya: Good. Please open a small post-mortem/incident: include provisioner logs, queue backlog snapshot, and whether the webhook to project-controller had transient 5xx. Action item: add 3x retry + exponential backoff to binds and alert if a binding remains unbound after 60s. Assign to eng-provisioning.
acctmgr_lucas: Noted — customer is on Dedicated trial so I'll follow up personally to confirm no impact to their evaluation. Thanks for the quick turnaround.
support_ash: Closing ticket after customer confirmation. Filed follow-up note in the ticket and will attach the log snippet. :thumbsup:
eng_maya: Thanks team.
